task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! First thing I need you to do is to go south. And then, doublecheck that the portal is wide open. And then, try to go to the east. With that done, make an attempt to venture south. And then, pick up the sandwich from the floor of the cookhouse. And once you've done that, you win!
